title: 口语练习
subtitle: 每天 10 分钟 · 共 5 天
steps: 点 🔊 听一遍，听清语调
一句一句跟着读，声音要大，不怕错
读完点「今天完成了」打卡

sentences.en: What will the world be like in fifty years?
sentences.zh: 五十年后世界会是什么样？

sentences.en: I think robots will take over many jobs.
sentences.zh: 我认为机器人会接管很多工作。

sentences.en: Will people live in outer space?
Maybe, as long as the technology is safe.
Scientists hope to find a cure for cancer.
sentences.zh: 科学家希望找到治疗癌症的方法。

sentences.en: Shall we go to the concert together?
sentences.zh: 我们一起去听音乐会好吗？

sentences.en: My phone is running low on power.
Your dream will come true if you work hard.
sentences.zh: 只要你努力，梦想就会实现。

sentences.en: The future depends on what we do today.
sentences.zh: 未来取决于我们今天所做的事。

plan.title: 跟读第 4–6 句

plan.title: 跟读第 7–9 句

plan.title: 不看书，说给家长听

plan.title: 自己说 3 句话
